subject.title: fix(ollama): remote Ollama streaming stalls at model_call:started on slow hosts

question: Should native Ollama streaming treat `timeoutSeconds` as an idle no-progress timeout while chunks arrive, matching sibling streaming transports?
rationale: The code evidence supports the narrow fix, but changing an existing provider timeout from wall-clock behavior to progress-refreshed behavior is compatibility-sensitive and needs maintainer acceptance before merge.

options.title: Require remote Ollama proof first
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, or a short recording showing an OpenClaw chat or provider run completing against a remote or slow Ollama host with this patch.

options.title: Accept unit-proofed idle-timeout parity
options.body: Maintainers may decide the sibling transport contract is sufficient and accept the timeout semantics after normal exact-head CI, despite the missing remote-host run.

options.title: Pause for a different canonical fix
options.body: If maintainers do not want idle-timeout semantics for Ollama, keep the linked issue open and close or supersede this PR with a different proof-backed approach.

recommendation.title: Require remote Ollama proof first
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, or a short recording showing an OpenClaw chat or provider run completing against a remote or slow Ollama host with this patch.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Ollama stream/runtime work makes this the strongest available routing signal for the timeout-semantics decision.
